text:
carmen_prod: Quick follow-up from the UX review: the help panel uses 'Workflows' but the Console nav and docs use 'Pipelines'. New users are getting mixed signals. Can we align before the next release?

yuri_design: Good catch. The snippet composer pulls the first paragraph; if that paragraph still has the old term we get mismatch.

carmen_prod: Also noticed deep links from the panel sometimes scroll to the wrong section because anchors changed after a docs edit.

natalie_docs: I ran a fast grep and found 4 pages using 'Workflows'. We should pick a canonical term. Recommend 'Pipelines' to match the nav and product copy.

yuri_design: Agree on 'Pipelines'. Also propose the help panel show only a 1-line summary + an explicit 'Open full docs' (new tab) CTA to avoid modal focus issues.

ishaan_eng: For anchors, our static site generator renames slugs when headings change. Quick fix: build a redirects.json mapping legacy anchors to canonical slugs and let the console rewrite links. Longer term: add a canonical_slug frontmatter field so slugs stay stable.

natalie_docs: Example redirects.json I can add to the build: {"workflows":"pipelines","workflow-troubleshooting":"pipelines-troubleshoot"}. I'll also add a small banner when a redirect occurs: "You were redirected from a legacy link 	4."

yuri_design: Accessibility: if the link opens in a modal, ensure focus lands on the H2 and that aria-modal=true is set. If we open in a new tab we avoid the focus trap. Also check color contrast on panel snippet in dark mode. It was borderline.

ishaan_eng: I'll implement client-side rewrite + analytics event docs_deeplink_redirect that includes originalHash and finalSlug. Also add a feature flag so we can toggle the rewrite if anything breaks.

natalie_docs: I'll standardize docs to 'Pipelines' and output redirects.json in the next build. I'll also patch the excerpt generator to prefer canonical term replacements during excerpt creation to reduce surface area of stale terms.

yuri_design: I'll update the help panel microcopy to title + 1-line blurb and add the new-tab CTA icon. I'll also adjust contrast tokens.

ci-bot: docs: PR #2314 opened by natalie_docs - "canonicalize pipelines + redirects" (labels: docs, a11y).

carmen_prod: Thanks — please @ me on the PRs. Timeline: PRs by EOD Wednesday, canary Thursday. We'll validate help panel deep links across a couple of tenants (incl. private deploy).

ishaan_eng: Will include a small runbook step to purge CDN if we need a full rebuild; feature flag for client rewrite makes rollback easy.

yuri_design: If redirects are slow to land we can fall back to linking to the doc top with a CTA to search within the page. Safer but less precise.

natalie_docs: Adding that fallback to the PR as an option behind a flag.

carmen_prod: Great. Small alignment but big UX win for onboarding. Closing loop for now :tada:
